content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The core issue for digital creators in restricted regions is the lack of reliable payment processing options. Traditional platforms often charge exorbitant fees, limiting your profits. For instance, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, while using NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This fundamental difference in fees can dramatically impact your earnings, especially for creators selling high-volume products. By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, you empower yourself to fully own your business and retain more profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The sovereign digital commerce stack operates on a combination of free and low-cost tools. Hosting can be handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with backend logic executed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be managed using Supabase or even Google Sheets, while file delivery is achieved using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrating NOWPayments facilitates crypto payment processing with automatic transaction verification. This architecture not only removes reliance on traditional payment platforms but also ensures that you maintain full ownership of your data and products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for creators in regions facing payment limitations. If you're selling digital products like ebooks, courses, or design assets and are tired of dealing with platform restrictions, this is your answer. The architecture removes barriers and allows you to reach global customers directly. It provides a streamlined process, enabling you to focus on creating and selling rather than navigating complex payment systems. This approach is not just a workaround; it is a robust, sovereign infrastructure.
Retain more profits by eliminating high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the heart of this system are several key components: hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend processing using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Each element plays a crucial role in ensuring seamless operation. For instance, while GitHub Pages provides a reliable hosting platform, NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC or buyer accounts, making transactions simple and efficient. The combination of these tools creates a comprehensive ecosystem for digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the components you need for your sovereign stack. Deploy your website using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle orders. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Lastly, store your product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy delivery. This straightforward process puts you in control of your digital products, allowing you to sell without the limitations of traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, focus on using crypto payment solutions like NOWPayments alongside a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach allows you to retain more profits and avoid platform fees. By deploying your own digital store using free tools, you can effectively manage sales and deliver your products without reliance on traditional payment processors.
Enjoy full ownership of your digital products and customer data.

Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital product and target audience. Choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend processing with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. Store your digital files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your setup to ensure seamless operation. Launch your online store and promote it to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell design assets without using Gumroad or Payhip?
You can establish your own online store using free hosting and backend tools. Implement NOWPayments for crypto payments to handle transactions directly, effectively bypassing traditional platforms.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for crypto transactions?
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad. This means more profit for you, especially as your sales volume increases.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, you can leverage Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of digital products immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?
Absolutely. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wider audience by accepting payments in various digital currencies.
What tools do I need to set up my store?
You will need a hosting service like GitHub Pages, backend services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, file storage via Google Drive, and NOWPayments for processing payments.
